text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~♪ Roasted carrots really hit the spot after practice~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Freshly made and piping hot is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I dropped it!
I only got to take one bite~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: In that case... wanna split this in half?♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, really!
I do this all the time with my little sisters!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: N-No, that's not it, I mean, um...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just read a manga where love started from a single carrot...
I-It kinda makes me feel all embarrassed~...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Y-You don't need to remember that kind of stuff~~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez... Here, let's split it in half.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah…… Thanks, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Those two up front are as close as ever, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Peak youth vibes, right?
Total besties energy, so emo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just because you got carried away and threw your carrots,
doesn't mean I'm gonna share mine with ya~

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real? How'd you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Palmer-san sees right through you♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, you are so Palmer!
Why do you get me so well!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I love that about you so much, Palmer~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Why, thank you.
I really dig that honest side of yours too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!
This is the most heart-throbbing thing EVER--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright♪ Come on, let's eat the carrots before they get cold!
